A wide paved airport apron with yellow taxiway markings and visible cracks, flanked by large corrugated metal hangars with segmented doors and small windows. A tall floodlight mast stands between the buildings, and distant mountain ridges are visible under a soft sunset sky.
Protagonist: A man with a shaved head wearing a black tactical vest over a dark shirt, olive cargo trousers and tan work boots, holding a handgun with both hands in a firing stance.
Companions: A man with dark hair wearing a forest bomber jacket, a white t-shirt, blue jeans and white sneakers, holding a handgun with both hands in a firing stance. A man with a shaved head wearing a grey hoodie, black trousers and grey sneakers, holding a handgun with both hands in a firing stance.
Action timeline: From 0.00 to 3.27 s: The protagonist keeps a handgun raised in both hands, aimed at the armed people in front of them, and fires at them; they fire back while another armed person walks into view. From 3.27 to 5.00 s: The protagonist shoots armed person 3, who collapses to the ground within about half a second, then lies motionless for the rest of the shot; everyone else stays on their feet, the protagonist keeps the handgun raised and the other armed people keep firing back.
